feature/adhkar.feature_adhkar_tap_hint: Tap a card each time you say it. It moves on by itself when done.

feature/adhkar.feature_adhkar_all_done: All done. May Allah accept it from you.

feature/hadith.feature_hadith_arabic_note: The full collections are in Arabic, with each hadith's number and its grading by a named scholar.
feature/hadith.feature_hadith_search: Search the Arabic text or a number
feature/hadith.feature_hadith_all_authentic: Every hadith in this collection is authentic (sahih) by scholarly consensus.
feature/hadith.feature_hadith_graded: Each hadith shows a scholar's grading: green authentic, blue good, amber weak, red fabricated.

feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_welcome_body: Your daily companion for prayer, the Quran and remembering Allah.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_location_body: Prayer times depend on your location. It stays on your phone.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_location_failed: Couldn't get your location. Search for your city instead.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_location_permission_d: Location access is off. You can search for your city instead.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_location_no_results: No city found. Try another spelling.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_method_body: Choose the method your local mosque follows. You can change it any time.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_method_asr_body: In the Ḥanafī school, ʿAsr begins later.
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_highlight_times: Prayer times and an adhan you can rely on
feature/onboarding.feature_onboarding_highlight_quran: The Quran with tafsir and recitations

feature/qibla.feature_qibla_no_location: Set your location first, from Settings.
feature/qibla.feature_qibla_no_compass: This phone has no compass. Use the bearing below with a compass.
feature/qibla.feature_qibla_tip: Hold the phone flat, away from metal and magnets.
feature/qibla.feature_qibla_calibrate: The compass needs calibrating: move the phone in a figure 8 a few times.

feature/quran.feature_quran_bookmarks_empty: Tap a verse while reading to bookmark it.
feature/quran.feature_quran_reciter_note: Recitations stream from everyayah.com and are kept on your phone after the first play.
feature/quran.feature_quran_player_offline: Couldn't play. Recitations need the internet the first time.
feature/quran.feature_quran_player_hint: Press play to recite from the verse at the top
feature/quran.feature_quran_tafsir_offline: This tafsir downloads the first time you open a surah. Connect to the internet and try again, or choose al-Jalalayn, which works offline.
feature/quran.feature_quran_meaning_credit: Translation of the meaning by M. Pickthall (1930)

feature/reliability.feature_reliability_subtitle: A few settings so Android never silences the adhan.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_step_notifications_b: So the adhan can show the prayer's name and a Stop button.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_step_exact_body: So the adhan starts on time, not minutes late.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_step_battery_body: Otherwise the battery saver can hold the adhan back. If your phone asks, choose “Allow background activity” or “Unrestricted”.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_step_background_body: Many phones add their own limits on top of Android, called auto-start, app launch or background activity. If yours has one, allow it for Deen. If you can't find it, your phone doesn't need it: just tick the box.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_step_recents_body: On some phones, clearing recent apps also stops their alarms. Open recent apps, long-press Deen's card (or swipe it down) and tap Lock if your phone offers it.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_test_body: Tap the button, lock your phone and wait one minute. If you hear the adhan, everything works.
feature/reliability.feature_reliability_outcome_late: Too late: the phone held it back

feature/settings.feature_settings_style_body: The same app in four looks. Colours stay as you chose them.
feature/settings.feature_settings_custom_body: Choose the two colours of the gradient. The rest of the app is coloured to match.
feature/settings.feature_settings_fajr_note: The bundled recordings are the regular adhan. For Fajr you can choose your own recording that includes “as-salātu khayrun mina-n-nawm”.
feature/settings.feature_settings_reminder_body: A quiet heads-up before the adhan.
feature/settings.feature_settings_respect_silent_body: When the phone is on silent, vibrate instead of playing the adhan.
feature/settings.feature_settings_timetable_body: Prayer times by date, Hijri or Gregorian
feature/settings.feature_settings_translation_body: English meaning under adhkar and hadith (English only).
feature/settings.feature_settings_haptics_body: A light tap on each count in the tasbih and adhkar.
feature/settings.feature_settings_secrets_unlocked: Hidden options unlocked. Find them in Settings.
feature/settings.feature_settings_masjid: Remind me to go to the masjid
feature/settings.feature_settings_masjid_body: A notification before the prayer, with time to walk there.
feature/settings.feature_settings_sources_body: Where the Quran, hadith, adhkar and recordings come from
feature/settings.feature_settings_sources_intro: Deen is free and open source. Every text and recording comes from a named source under a licence that allows it.
feature/settings.feature_settings_after_adhan: Remind me to pray after the adhan
feature/settings.feature_settings_after_adhan_body: Optional. A gentle nudge a few minutes after each adhan; choose the time for each prayer.
feature/settings.feature_settings_privacy_body: No ads, no tracking, no account. Everything works offline except Quran recitations and the longer tafsirs, which download when you open them. Nothing about you is sent.
feature/settings.feature_settings_voice_pick_body: Pick any audio file on your phone, up to 25 MB. Deen keeps its own copy, so it still plays if you move or delete the original.
feature/settings.feature_settings_voice_too_large: That file is larger than 25 MB.
feature/settings.feature_settings_voice_not_audio: That file doesn't look like a playable recording (3 seconds to 15 minutes).
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_quran_body: Tanzil Project, Uthmani text 1.1, used verbatim under CC BY 3.0. Font: Amiri Quran.
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_hadith_body: Arabic text, numbering and gradings of the six books, the Muwatta and the Forty Qudsi from hadith-api (Unlicense). The texts are classical and in the public domain.
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_adhkar_body: Morning and evening adhkar in the wording of Hisn al-Muslim, from Seen-Arabic (MIT). Other adhkar taken from the cited hadith and checked against them.
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_english_body: The English of the adhkar, an-Nawawi's Forty and the facts about the Prophet ﷺ was written for Deen and is awaiting review by a qualified reviewer.
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_adhan_body: Wikimedia Commons: “Beautiful adhan” (CC0), “Azan” by Andrewler (CC BY-SA 4.0), “The Adhan – Aaqib Azeez” uploaded by Atcovi (CC BY-SA 4.0, loudness adjusted).
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_tafsir_body: Tafsir al-Jalalayn is on your phone. Ibn Kathir, al-Baghawi and al-Qurtubi download from the tafsir_api dataset (MIT) the first time you open a surah. All are classical texts. English meaning: M. Pickthall (1930, public domain).
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_recitation_body: Recitations stream from EveryAyah.com and stay on your phone after the first play. Word timings for the highlighting: quran-align by Collin Fair (CC BY 4.0).
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_times_body: Calculated on your phone with adhan-kotlin by Batoul Apps (MIT).
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_fonts_body: Readex Pro, Amiri and Amiri Quran (SIL Open Font License). Material Symbols (Apache 2.0).
feature/settings.feature_settings_src_app_body: Free software under GPL-3.0-or-later. No ads, no tracking.
